name: Dragon Adventures
notes: Dragon Adventures 0.9.3-r2: a mounted Q tap always runs the full 2.8s minimum burn (cone, mesh, glow, fire icon, Whoosh) even if keyup arrives in the same task or 0-50 ms later. The window is wall-clock and independent of rAF; a longer hold keeps burning until release. Fire visuals start only from Q (an on-foot Q no longer leaves a burst that can Whoosh after mounting). ?debug=keys logs the keydown line before toast/fx and labels that same keydown (a leftover on-foot decision cannot stick to the next Q). Pickaxe clicks aim-assist a rock that is in range and roughly in front, and still show Click to mine this rock. Schema v5, IDB/cacheId/test-* denylist unchanged. Do not mutate after SHA256SUMS.
